name: Disc Cascade
description: A disc cut from the middle of the first clip makes a half turn, then the four discs inscribed in the quarters of the frame, then sixteen smaller ones; the smallest discs spin a full turn while the picture changes to the second clip, whose larger discs then turn back one size at a time until it is whole. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: levels
params.description: Number of disc sizes: 1, 4, 16 then 64 discs

params.name: shadow
params.description: Strength of the shadows the turning discs cast
